topic: Markhor: Pakistan's national animal, a wild goat with long spiral horns that climbs steep cliffs with ease.

episode.title: Wild Superpowers: Markhor, the Cliff-Climbing Goat!

shots.narration: Did you know this wild goat climbs amazingly steep cliffs?
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, bright 3D animated mountain landscape; a cute, realistic markhor stands on a steep rocky slope beneath sunny skies; no text.
shots.action: The markhor steps onto a higher rocky ledge.
shots.mood: Sunlit rock faces, thrilling height, gentle adventure.

shots.narration: Kiko and Pip have found a markhor!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, sunny mountain valley in bright natural colours; Kiko wears his green safari hat and pocketed khaki vest, with emerald-green, ruby-throated Pip beside him; a markhor stands uphill.
shots.action: Kiko raises his big binoculars toward the markhor.
shots.mood: Wide curious eyes, warm sunshine, exciting discovery.

shots.narration: [surprised] But how will it climb that steep slope?
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, safe level valley floor beneath a steep mountain slope; Kiko and Pip remain far from the cliff edge; the markhor stands at the slope's base.
shots.action: Kiko points up the steep rock face.
shots.mood: Raised eyebrows, towering rocks, curious suspense.

shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, realistic cute markhor on a mountain ledge, rugged peaks behind it, bright 3D animated nature-film look; no text or symbols.
shots.action: The markhor turns its head toward the valley.
shots.mood: Proud stance, golden sunshine, magnificent mountain scenery.

shots.narration: Look at those long spiral horns!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, close view of the markhor's face and long corkscrew-shaped horns against a clear blue mountain sky, realistic anatomy and soft 3D fur.
shots.action: The markhor tilts its head slightly.
shots.mood: Sparkling daylight, striking horn silhouettes, quiet wonder.

shots.narration: [excited] Its real superpower? Climbing steep cliffs with ease!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, steep rocky mountainside with natural ledges; the same markhor appears in full body, with the valley visible below.
shots.action: The markhor climbs a sequence of rocky footholds.
shots.mood: Confident movement, bright sunshine, exciting upward progress.

shots.narration: That rocky route is no problem for this mountain climber.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, upper mountain ledge above the steep route, sparse alpine grass and sunlit stone, bright naturalistic 3D animation.
shots.action: The markhor steps onto the broad upper ledge.
shots.mood: Open sky, relaxed posture, triumphant arrival.

shots.narration: Kiko stays safely below, enjoying the incredible view.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, wide level valley floor; Kiko and Pip face the distant markhor on its high ledge, surrounded by sunny mountain scenery.
shots.action: Kiko watches the markhor through his binoculars.
shots.mood: Delighted smile, peaceful distance, satisfying discovery.

shots.narration: [whispers] Another wild superpower awaits. Can you guess our next animal?
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, Kiko and Pip on a safe mountain valley trail leading toward a bend, bright 3D foliage and distant sunny peaks; no other animals or text.
shots.action: Kiko points toward the trail's hidden bend.
shots.mood: Playful anticipation, inviting trail, sunny adventure ahead.

episode.endHook: Which animal's wild superpower will Kiko and Pip discover next?
episode.description: Discover the markhor, Pakistan's national animal, with Kiko and Pip! This wild goat has long spiral horns and an amazing talent for climbing steep cliffs.
